# Bookmark

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Bookmark`](gmeow-Bookmark.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Bookmark>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/notes`](../../slices/notes.md)

An annotation that records a target resource for later retrieval, motivated by bookmarking. Typically has no body and no selector (the target entity itself is the bookmarked resource).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Annotation`](gmeow-Annotation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Bookmark`](gmeow-Bookmark.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Annotation`](gmeow-Annotation.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
